candidate.gap_origin: Untried element pair O-As from literature co-occurrence analysis

verification_notes: Favorable polar-covalent / metallic hybridization for electronic transport.
High precompression index (0.89): Dopant cations induce steric pressure, stabilizing H-clathrate cage at reduced external pressure.

starting_precursors: High-purity (As, O) metal foil or powder (purity $\ge 99.99\%$), stoichiometrically weighed.
Ammonia borane (NH3BH3) or pure molecular H2 gas loading as clean hydrogen donor.
Rhenium or tungsten gasket pre-indented to 25-35 $\mu$m thickness with 100 $\mu$m sample chamber.

synthesis_conditions.pressure: 159.8 GPa (monitored via diamond anvil Raman / ruby fluorescence)
synthesis_conditions.temperature: 1800 - 2200 K (double-sided pulsed Nd:YAG laser heating at $\lambda=1064$ nm)
synthesis_conditions.duration: 10 - 20 minutes laser annealing to induce cage phase nucleation
synthesis_conditions.atmosphere: Cryogenic or pressurized hydrogen environment inside sealed DAC

characterization_plan: In-situ Synchrotron Powder X-ray Diffraction ($\lambda=0.434$ Å) to confirm Fm-3m (#225) clathrate lattice formation.
Four-probe electrical resistance using sputtered Pt/Ti microelectrodes deposited on diamond culet.
Measure resistance transition: verify zero-resistance state in predicted Tc window (245.0 - 280.0 K).
Magnetic susceptibility / AC susceptibility to confirm Meissner diamagnetic shielding.
safety_notes: Extreme pressure risk: Diamond anvil culet cleavage during laser pulsing; operate behind blast shielding.
Pressurized hydrogen embrittlement: Inspect gasket seal integrity prior to heating.

candidate.gap_origin: Untried element pair C-Cs from literature co-occurrence analysis

verification_notes: High electronegativity delta (2.65); potential ionic insulating tendency.
Goldschmidt tolerance factor t=0.936 within optimal cubic/orthorhombic perovskite stability window.

starting_precursors: Stoichiometric oxides/carbonates of Ba, C, Cs, Cu, O (e.g. BaCO3, CuO, Y2O3).
Single-crystal substrate: SrTiO3 (001) or LaAlO3 (001) for epitaxial film growth.

synthesis_conditions.pressure: 0.2 - 0.4 mbar dynamic O2 partial pressure during ablation; 1 atm post-anneal
synthesis_conditions.duration: 45 minutes ablation at 2-5 Hz KrF excimer laser ($\lambda=248$ nm)
synthesis_conditions.atmosphere: Pure oxygen (O2) environment to eliminate oxygen vacancies

characterization_plan: High-resolution XRD $\theta-2\theta$ scans to verify c-axis epitaxial orientation and space group Pmmm (#47).
Four-point probe electrical resistivity from 300 K down to 4.2 K in cryostat.
SQUID vibrating sample magnetometry (VSM) to quantify superconducting volume fraction.
safety_notes: UV Excimer Laser radiation hazard: Class 4 laser safety goggles required during PLD ablation.
Fine oxide/carbonate particulate inhalation risk during stoichiometric powder grinding.
